blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Zambales fisherfolk have renewed their grievances over their diminished access to traditional fishing grounds in Bajo de Masinloc following testimony in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial that a company linked to her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, received P319.33 million in remittances. Zambales Rep. Doris “Bing” Maniquiz said Sunday that fisherfolk had gradually accepted that they could no longer safely fish in Bajo de Masinloc, where Chinese vessels have been involved in incidents that endangered Filipino vessels. But testimony involving Cale88 Foods Corp. rekindled their questions and frustration over their loss of access to traditional fishing grounds. “Before, […]...
